تتراءي (form VI)
# تَتَرَاءَيْ (tatarāʔay) /ta.ta.raː.ʔaj/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَرَاءَى (tarāʔā)
# تُتَرَاءَيْ (tutarāʔay) /tu.ta.raː.ʔaj/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَرَاءَى (tarāʔā)
